sets.relationshipLabel: tool and the action it exists to perform
sets.explanation: A plectrum exists to pluck and a mallet exists to strike — each tool is defined by the single motion it was built for.

sets.relationshipLabel: written notation and the piece it records
sets.explanation: A score is the notation for a symphony and a lead sheet is the notation for a tune — the paper stands in for the performed piece.

sets.relationshipLabel: place an item is kept and the item kept there
sets.explanation: A gig bag holds a banjo and a pedalboard holds pedals — each is a dedicated home for the gear it carries.

sets.relationshipLabel: opening moment and closing moment of an event
sets.explanation: A soundcheck opens a show and an encore closes it, just as a debut opens a career and a farewell closes it — the same start-to-end shape at two different scales.
